document_data.title: Medication Update - Rheumatology Recommendations (2026-10-05)
document_data.content:
Based on Dr. Alvarez's rheumatology follow-up assessment dated 2026-10-05, the following medication changes were implemented per latest recommendations:

1. Hydroxychloroquine: Increased from 200mg to 400mg daily - per symptom report indications
2. Methotrexate: Re-initiated 25mg weekly (three times weekly, oral) for disease control
3. Prednisone 5mg: Continued as prescribed

Rationale: Patient experiencing symptom progression requiring intensified disease-modifying therapy. Allergies reviewed - none to new medications. Conditions: Rheumatoid arthritis requiring ongoing management.

Actioned on request from Dr. Samuel Osei's nursing team.
Documented with patient consent.
